Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The ECS computation (attention-based cosine similarity), PKS computation (JS divergence), and classifier training pipeline are clearly documented. Code in compute_scores.py, classifier.py, and predict.py implements the methodology with clear function names. No major inference or guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment can be restored without issues. Uses standard Python packages (scikit-learn, numpy, pandas, torch, xgboost). Pre-computed scores eliminate need for heavy model loading. requirements.txt provides all dependencies. No version conflicts encountered. Successfully ran on provided CUDA environment.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are stable and reproducible. Random seeds controlled (RANDOM_STATE=42). Replicated SVC validation F1 (76.01%) closely matches paper (76.60%). Response-level test F1 (73.42%) within 1.26% of pre-trained model (74.68%). Correlation analysis produces consistent statistical results. Minor variance attributable to train/val split randomization.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Not applicable. Repository provides full replication capability with pre-computed scores and complete pipeline scripts, not just a demo workflow. Full end-to-end replication was performed.
